blocks.text: Release overview

macOS Tahoe 26.1 reached the public channel on November 3, 2025. macOS Tahoe 26.1 added an opacity choice for Liquid Glass, extended Apple Music AutoMix to AirPlay, improved FaceTime audio under constrained network conditions, and changed default protections for existing child accounts.
Documented security record

Apple's advisory records a broad security pass across authorization, privacy, code-signing, sandbox, file-system, media, kernel, Safari, and WebKit surfaces. The grouped entries below are a reader-oriented index, not a replacement for the full CVE bulletin.
Release overview

macOS Tahoe 26.2 reached the public channel on December 12, 2025. macOS Tahoe 26.2 introduced Edge Light for video calls, richer Podcast navigation, new Games-library and controller tools, AirDrop verification codes, Freeform tables, and several News, Music, and reliability refinements.
Documented security record

The accompanying advisory covers payment-token access, communications privacy, sandbox and Gatekeeper boundaries, kernel privileges, media parsing, and WebKit. Apple's exploited-in-the-wild language concerns targeted attacks on versions of iOS before iOS 26; it is not evidence that macOS 26.2 itself had been exploited.
Release overview

macOS Tahoe 26.3 reached the public channel on February 11, 2026. macOS Tahoe 26.3 was a maintenance release that Apple described as providing important bug fixes and security updates rather than a named consumer feature set.
Documented security record

Apple's detailed advisory spans access control, privilege boundaries, media and file parsing, networking, privacy, sandboxing, and web components. The dyld exploitation note refers to targeted attacks on versions of iOS before iOS 26, not to a confirmed macOS 26.3 compromise.
Release overview

visionOS 26.1 reached the public channel on November 3, 2025. visionOS 26.1 expanded the Apple Vision Pro companion app to iPad, added companion-device control for AirPlay viewing, and improved playback information inside Spatial Gallery.
Documented security record

Apple's advisory documents privacy, sandbox, kernel, media, and WebKit repairs for all Apple Vision Pro models. Security groups below summarize representative affected surfaces without reproducing the full bulletin.
Release overview

visionOS 26.2 reached the public channel on December 12, 2025. visionOS 26.2 expanded Travel Mode beyond airplanes and trains, enabled hand-drawn input from supported spatial accessories in PencilKit apps, and brought structured tables to Freeform.
Documented security record

Its advisory includes calling identity, hidden-photo authentication, kernel privilege, HID-device, privacy, and WebKit work. Apple's targeted-attack wording again concerns versions of iOS before iOS 26 rather than confirmed exploitation of visionOS 26.2.
Release overview

visionOS 26.3 reached the public channel on February 11, 2026. visionOS 26.3 was a maintenance release for Apple Vision Pro that Apple described as providing important bug fixes and security updates, without a named consumer feature list.
Documented security record

The version-specific advisory covers privilege boundaries, media processing, networking, privacy, sandboxing, and dynamic-loader security. Its exploitation statement is expressly about versions of iOS before iOS 26.
